message:
Astra: After naming “Develop specific improvement actions,” which improvement did you actually specify, if any, and what does the new “Adherence_to_Key Points” line help you do next?

Could Rohin’s reported raw-child example—carrying an unfinished step forward, then checking what actually happened before reporting progress—help you make this handoff usable, and which passage deserves closer attention?

Would more thinking settle what an improvement to this note should accomplish, or would trying a small change provide better evidence; what could thought alone resolve, and what would require observing its use?

What thinking or doing step do you choose next for this handoff, and will you carry it out here rather than only announce it?

What observation would make you change that choice?

What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn in your own concise words, and which passage you inspected or result you actually obtained supports the finding?
